articles.description: Free-tier pricing is a common marketing strategy. “Free” gets people in the door and allows them to settle in and see how things work. And while the distinction may be nuanced, the consequences of sunsetting free-tier pricing may be huge.

articles.description: Conducting UX research that includes participants with a variety of disabilities is vital to building inclusive technology, but most prototypes used for testing are inaccessible.
